results.title: REJACKED
results.overview: In the throes of societal and political uncertainty, 3 queer women turn sexual and gender-based violence on its head.

results.title: Shrill
results.overview: Joana, a film director with an identity and career crisis, is wrapping up a documentary about Sandra, the clientless touristic guide of a very untouristic walking trail.

results.title: Burner
results.overview: Ex-con single mom Kiki rebuilds her life and regains custody of her teen daughter, until her violent drug-dealer ex returns. To protect herself and her daughter, she must eliminate him without getting caught.

results.title: Irma half asleep
results.overview: Irma is half asleep, her boyfriend is fast asleep next to her. Dream and memory are strangely mixed. Irma knows that when she wakes up, her boyfriend will tell her, that he doesn't love her anymore.

results.title: Maargan
results.overview: ADGP Dhruv, a seasoned high-ranking police officer haunted by a tragic past, grapples with a labyrinthine case, where every clue unearths a darker secret. As he uncovers clues linking to a mysterious swimmer, he races against time to stop a cunning serial killer driven by dark secrets.

results.title: Bhuthan: The World’s Happiest Man
results.overview: Bhutan: The World’s Happiest Man tells the story of Mr. Bishnu, an aging Bhutanese-American in Ohio, who dreams of returning to his homeland. After his unexpected death, his family faces a conflict over his final resting place, torn between past memories and present realities. This emotional drama explores themes of love, loss, and the search for belonging.

results.title: Trife
results.overview: A homeless father’s desperate act to help his young son after a basketball injury leads to an unexpected shot at redemption.

results.title: Seek
results.overview: Kyohei Aizawa, an assassin for a covert non-governmental espionage group in Japan called "四十九" or "SEEK", is grieving over the loss of his girlfriend from a tragic plane accident.  The leader of “SEEK”,Ryo Mikumo, contacts him for an emergency mission; save a fellow agent, recover a new highly explosive liquid called “RDX@“, stop a ruthless Yakuza leader, Sojiro Kotsuki, and his gang before they take over Japan.  Although the Ninjas were thought to have disappeared...the new breed of assassins live on helping to protect Japan and all that is right; the Ninjas are coming soon.

results.title: The Big Problem
results.overview: Max and Tima work for a crime boss. But things don't go according to plan when Max decides he's capable of more.

results.title: Dorians
results.overview: An action fantasy short film following the story of a group of orphans surviving in the forest. Theo believes living in isolation keeps them safe from killers. Life's simple until they reach the forest's edge and encounter other people. The Dorians.  The Dorians accept them. Theo develops a relationship with Pip. Struggling to adapt to this new way of life, he returns to isolation. Theo's sister is left vulnerable.  The Dorians unsuccessfully convince him to come back. He is faced with a heart-breaking discovery, which provokes his return. Having a new lease of life, his relationship with Pip is restored.

results.title: Eugene the Marine
results.overview: A former marine fights to keep his life from unraveling as his son tries to force him out of his longtime family home and a series of gruesome murders begin targeting the people around him.

results.title: Hélène Sio en live dans la collection Emporte La Nuit
results.original_title: Hélène Sio en live dans la collection Emporte La Nuit

results.title: We Kill Them All
results.overview: A young woman travels to a secluded resort where her estranged and criminal father seeks to mend their relationship. Upon her arrival, she and her girlfriend are confronted by dangerous men from her father's past and must fight for their lives.

results.title: Interfuit
results.original_title: それはかつてあったから
results.overview: Bridal photographer Makoto Aira lost his father to illness. However, even after the funeral, he struggled to come to terms with his emotions. Two years later, he is given the opportunity to photograph the funeral of his friend’s father. As he prepares to face this “new funeral,” he revisits his father’s online funeral venue. There, he comes across messages from people who knew his father in the past and discovers a side of him he had never seen before. To mourn once more, he gazes at his father’s portrait in the virtual space, reflecting on his life and legacy.

results.title: Rabbit Ears
results.overview: What happens to a child when a parent dies young? Eloise's mum passed away when she was little. now, Eloise wants to reclaim her life, but that means being honest with herself and confronting her grief. Is she ready to let go? Sort of.

results.title: Madrina
results.overview: A conflicted woman returns home for the holidays after two years of no contact. Under the leering eyes of family, she regains her voice in defense of herself and her autonomy. When she gets kicked out of Christmas dinner, she cherishes her one remaining connection with her godmother.

results.title: The Dance Club
results.overview: Johannes, an eccentric psychology student, takes us on a twisted journey. Together with performance artist Rakel, he forms an unconventional club with his patients to help them fight back against those who have caused them pain. As the club grows, Johannes struggles to keep it together, while inconveniently falling head over heels for Rakel.

results.title: The Super
results.overview: When a brutal killer gets a noise complaint from Senora Fernandez, will he be able to keep his brutal tendencies from bubbling to the surface?
